chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Shaybani, may Allah be pleased with him, told us: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi told us: Sahl ibn Ziyad told us, from Abdul-Adhim ibn Abdullah al-Hasani, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Askari, peace be upon him, say:

The meaning of 'Al-Rajim' (The Stoned) is that he is stoned with curses, expelled from places of goodness, and no believer remembers him except to curse him. And in the Preceding Knowledge of Allah, when the Riser (Al-Qa'im), peace be upon him, comes out, there will not remain a believer in his time except that he will stone him with stones, just as he was before that stoned with curses.

key_terms.عِلْمُ اللَّهِ السَّابِقُ: The Preceding Knowledge of Allah (Divine Decree)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Al-Rajim and how will believers treat him in the time of Al-Qa'im?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam Ali al-Hadi (AS), the term 'Al-Rajim' is defined not merely as 'stoned' but as one eternally expelled from divine goodness and cursed by believers. The hadith introduces a unique eschatological transformation: upon the emergence of Al-Qa'im (the Twelfth Imam), the mode of 'stoning' shifts from verbal cursing to physical stoning by the believers themselves, signifying a transition from passive rejection to active, tangible opposition or purification. This reflects the Shia scholarly view of the 'Rajim' (often identified with Satan or the disbelievers) as a figure whose status is confirmed and enacted by the faithful in the end times.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Ahmad al-Shaybani, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abi Abdillah al-Kufi, that he said: We were told by Sahl bin Ziyad, from Abdul-Adhim bin Abdullah al-Hasani, that he said: I heard Abu’l-Hasan, Ali bin Muhammed al-Askari, peace be upon him, say:

The meaning of the Stoned is that he is Stoned with Curses, expelled from the places of goodness, not remembered by a believer except that he curses him, and that there is in the Knowledge of Allah that precedes events that when the Riser, peace be upon him, comes out, there will not remain a believer in his age except that he will stone him with stones, like how he was, before that, stoned with curses.
